panorama_note: The fountain basin carries carved reliefs and the fountain is the main subject. It is a modern work in public space, and freedom of panorama in Bosnia and Herzegovina does not cover commercial use of works of art in public space, so the photo licence alone may not clear the fountain itself for commercial use. GoatConf is free and non-commercial, which lowers the risk; ask the city before using it on anything sold or sponsored.
